title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 46
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 46: the word concerning the nations, the defeat of Egypt by the river Euphrates, and the comfort given to Jacob.

questions.text: Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning what?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 46:1 says this was Yahweh's word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

answers.text: Concerning the priests
Concerning the house of David
Concerning the nations
Concerning the exiles in Babylon

questions.text: Whose army by the river Euphrates in Carchemish did Nebuchadnezzar strike?
questions.explanation: The word is of Egypt, concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which Nebuchadnezzar struck at Carchemish by the river Euphrates.

answers.text: The army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt
The army of Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt
The army of the king of Assyria
The army of the Philistines of Gaza

questions.text: What does the call to battle say to do with the spears?
questions.explanation: The call says to harness the horses, stand up with helmets, polish the spears and put on the coats of mail.

answers.text: Break them
Lay them down
Count them
Polish them

questions.text: Where had the swift and the mighty man stumbled and fallen?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says that in the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

answers.text: In the valley of Megiddo
In the north by the river Euphrates
By the sea of Galilee
On the banks of the Nile

questions.text: What does verse 8 say Egypt rises up like?
questions.explanation: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and his waters toss themselves like the rivers.

answers.text: Like a lion
Like an eagle
Like the Nile
Like a mountain

questions.text: Where is the virgin daughter of Egypt told to go up to take balm?
questions.explanation: She is told to go up into Gilead and take balm, and that she uses many medicines in vain.

answers.text: Into Gilead
Into Lebanon
To Carmel
To Tahpanhes

questions.text: What did they cry there about Pharaoh king of Egypt?
questions.explanation: They cried there that Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise, and that he has let the appointed time pass by.

answers.text: That he is a mighty lion among the nations
That he is but a noise, and has let the appointed time pass by
That he will come and save them from the sword
That he has gone away to Babylon with his army

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will happen to Memphis?
questions.explanation: The daughter who dwells in Egypt is told to furnish herself to go into captivity, for Memphis will become a desolation and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

answers.text: It will be rebuilt greater than it was before
It will be spared because of the gods of Egypt
It will be filled with people from the north
It will become a desolation, burned up and without inhabitant

questions.text: What kind of animal is Egypt called in verse 20?
questions.explanation: Egypt is called a very beautiful heifer, but destruction out of the north has come.

answers.text: A strong bull of the stall
A swift horse of the king
A very beautiful heifer
A wild donkey of the desert

questions.text: What does Yahweh say to Jacob his servant at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh tells Jacob his servant not to be afraid or dismayed, for he will save him from afar and bring his offspring back from the land of their captivity.

answers.text: Not to be afraid, for Yahweh will save him from afar
That Yahweh will make a full end of him
That Yahweh will leave him unpunished forever
That he must stay in captivity and not return
